Google Meet Attendance Tracker for Teachers in Indonesia

Asking every student to type "hadir" in the chat, then copying names into a spreadsheet after class, costs you time every single day. Here is how Indonesian teachers on Akun belajar.id, SMA/SMK educators, and university lecturers automate the daftar hadir in Google Meet and export it straight to Google Sheets.

Works with Akun belajar.id: Compatible with official Kemendikbudristek accounts (@guru.sma.belajar.id, @guru.smk.belajar.id, @guru.sd.belajar.id and student variants), school and campus domains (.sch.id, .ac.id), and personal @gmail.com accounts. The side panel is also available in Bahasa Indonesia.
Why Google Meet Never Sends a Daftar Hadir

Akun belajar.id gives Indonesian teachers a Google Workspace for Education account on the free Education Fundamentals tier. Google's built-in Meet attendance report is only included in the paid Education Plus licence — so after your online class, no attendance email or spreadsheet ever appears.

Attendance Tracker solves this inside the meeting itself. It is a certified Google Workspace Marketplace add-on running in the Google Meet side panel, and it works on every Workspace edition — belajar.id Fundamentals accounts and personal Gmail included.
Built for Indonesian Online Classrooms (PJJ & Hybrid)
📋 Daftar Hadir Otomatis
No more "ketik hadir di kolom chat". Every student is recorded automatically the moment they join, with name and email captured.
⏰ Late Arrival Flags
Students joining after the first 5 minutes get a clear late chip (e.g. +12m late) so punctuality shows in your record.
⏱️ Real Minutes, Not Just Presence
If a student's connection drops and they rejoin, their active minutes merge into one clean row — fair records even on unstable networks.
📊 1-Click Google Sheets Export
A tidy spreadsheet lands in your Google Drive, ready for your administrasi kelas or to share with your kepala sekolah.
⚡ Hands-Free Auto-Export
Turn on auto-export once, and every class saves and emails itself to you when the meeting ends.
🌏 Bahasa Indonesia Interface
The side panel follows your Google language setting — Bahasa Indonesia and 59 other languages are supported.
How to Take Attendance in Your Next Class
Install the add-on: Open the Attendance Tracker Marketplace page with your belajar.id or Gmail account and click Install.
Start Google Meet from Google Classroom or your class link as usual.
Open the side panel: Click the Activities / Add-ons icon next to the chat icon and choose Attendance Tracker.
Teach: The attendance list fills itself in as students join and leave.
Save: Click Save to Sheets, or enable auto-export so it saves automatically when class ends.
Frequently Asked Questions from Indonesian Teachers
Does it work on Akun belajar.id?

Yes. belajar.id accounts run Google Workspace for Education Fundamentals, and Attendance Tracker works on every Workspace edition. If your school admin restricts Marketplace installs, you can host the meeting from a personal Gmail account instead.
Can I use it for SMK practical classes and university lectures?
Yes. It works for small vocational groups and large campus lectures with 100+ students alike, whatever mix of belajar.id, campus, and personal accounts your students join with.
Is student data private?
Yes. Attendance Tracker never accesses your camera, microphone, or meeting content, shows no ads, and sells no data. Spreadsheets live only in your own Google Drive.
Is there a discount for teachers?

Yes! With regional pricing for Indonesia, the Educator Pass is Rp 49.000/year (Pro Annual Rp 99.000/year), or a one-time Lifetime Pass is Rp 99.000–Rp 199.000 — both include unlimited exports, hands-free auto-capture, and student attendance certificates. Basic tracking and 2 exports per month across Google Sheets, CSV, or binary Excel (for classes up to 25 attendees, plus 1 large-class grace export) are free forever.
